campaign.title.note: An autonomous run that writes, critiques and revises a book unattended

campaign.empty.title: No run yet
campaign.empty.intro: An autonomous run writes, critiques and revises a whole book while you are away. Start one in a terminal:

campaign.empty.pilot.note: Comment after an example command that runs three chapters as a trial

campaign.empty.book.note: Comment after an example command that runs a whole book

campaign.empty.plan.text: where each chapter stands, without running
campaign.empty.plan.note: Comment after an example command that only prints the plan

campaign.empty.resume.text: Ctrl-C stops it; the same command resumes. This page follows it live.
campaign.empty.resume.note: Ctrl-C is the key combination that stops a terminal command

campaign.kicker.note: Small heading above the run's name

campaign.status.running.note: Status of a run or a session

campaign.status.waiting.note: Status of a run paused until a usage limit resets

campaign.status.finished.note: Status of a run that has nothing left to do

campaign.status.stopped.note: Status of a run or session stopped by the user

campaign.status.interrupted.note: Status of a run whose process is gone without stopping cleanly

campaign.status.done.note: Status of a session that finished

campaign.status.failed.note: Status of a session that failed

campaign.status.limited.note: Status of a session cut short by a usage limit

campaign.status.unavailable.note: Status of a session that failed because the API was unavailable

campaign.phase.unwritten.note: A chapter layer not started yet

campaign.phase.drafts.note: A chapter layer written and waiting for the critic

campaign.phase.requested.note: A chapter layer the critic sent back, being revised

campaign.phase.failed.note: A chapter layer that failed three times

campaign.action.write.note: What a session does: write a layer

campaign.action.revise.note: What a session does: revise a layer after the critic's requests

campaign.action.critique.note: What a session does: critique a layer

campaign.layer.chronology.note: Layer of the corpus: events and their timing

campaign.layer.ontology.note: Layer of the corpus: people, places, states and rituals

campaign.layer.philology.note: Layer of the corpus: translations, glosses and commentary

campaign.layer.language.note: Column of a translation layer in the run grid; {lang} is a language code such as RU

campaign.cell.approved.note: Tooltip of a chapter layer: items approved

campaign.cell.drafts.note: Tooltip of a chapter layer: items still drafts

campaign.cell.sent_back.note: Tooltip of a chapter layer: items with change requests

campaign.cell.escalated.note: Tooltip of a chapter layer: items the critic escalated to the user

campaign.left.note: A chapter layer not written yet: items still to write

campaign.verdict.approved.note: What a critique session decided: items approved

campaign.verdict.requested.note: What a critique session decided: items with changes requested

campaign.verdict.escalated.note: What a critique session decided: items escalated to the user

campaign.verdict.kept.note: What a critique session decided: items kept as they were

campaign.error.note: Label before a session's error message

campaign.no_report.note: Shown when a session left no report

campaign.waiting.usage_limit.note: The run is paused because the model's usage limit was reached

campaign.waiting.api_failed.note: The run is paused because the model's API returned errors

campaign.waiting.until.text: Paused until {time}; it resumes on its own.

campaign.failed.title.note: Heading of the notice that some chapter layers failed

campaign.failed.text.one: {count} chapter layer failed three times in a row. {cmd} retries it; each session's error is under Sessions.
campaign.failed.text.other: {count} chapter layers failed three times in a row. {cmd} retries them; each session's error is under Sessions.
campaign.failed.text.note: {cmd} is a terminal command shown as code; 'Sessions' is the title of a panel on this page

campaign.interrupted.title.note: Heading of the notice that the run's process is gone

campaign.interrupted.text.text: The conductor is no longer running. {cmd} resumes it.
campaign.interrupted.text.note: The conductor is the process that runs the campaign; {cmd} is a terminal command shown as code

campaign.cost.note: {cost} is an amount in US dollars

campaign.started.note: {ago} is a relative time such as '3 h ago'

campaign.parallel.note: How many sessions run in parallel

campaign.max_rounds.note: The most critique rounds a chapter layer gets

campaign.sessions.note: Panel title: the list of agent sessions

campaign.now.note: Panel title: the sessions running at this moment

campaign.escalated.note: Panel title: items the critic could not settle and left to the user

campaign.none_escalated: Nothing yet: the critic has settled everything it reviewed.
